title: Manufacturing and Analysis of High-Performance Refractory High-Entropy Alloy via Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
process_description: prepared by selective laser melting (SLM) using FORWEDO LM120 equipment with a maximum power of 500 W fiber laser in a protective argon atmosphere (oxygen content <20 ppm). Substrate: C45 steel plate (50 mm × 50 mm × 20 mm). Sample dimensions: 10 mm × 10 mm × 0.5 mm. Parameters: laser scanning velocity 250 mm/s, hatch distance 0.1 mm, layer thickness 0.1 mm, laser power factor 0.8, with 2 additional remelting passes per layer (total 3× energy input).
